verdict.rationale: Aircall's API documents pausing and resuming recording on a call, and a tutorial covers importing recordings and voicemail into your own infrastructure. Together these imply calls are recorded and recordings can be retrieved, but nothing documents consent handling for any jurisdiction or in-app search of recordings. Missing for 10: jurisdiction-aware consent handling (announcements, opt-in/opt-out), documented recording settings, in-product recording search and playback, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can record calls with the consent handling my jurisdictions require and find the recordings later
